title: The librarian enters the person's name and email and registers them
description: The librarian takes the person's name and email and registers them (`POST /members`).

title: A blank name, a malformed email or an email already registered is refused
description: If the name is blank, the email is not an email address, or the email is already registered, the registration is refused and the librarian is told why.

title: The library shows the new member with the member ID for their card
description: The new member is shown as recorded, with the member ID to write on their card.

title: The librarian enters the tool's name and, optionally, a description, and adds it
description: The librarian adds the tool with its name and, optionally, a description (`POST /tools`).

title: A blank name is refused
description: If the name is blank, adding the tool is refused and the librarian is told why.

title: The new tool is in good condition, and the catalog lists it as available
description: The new tool starts in good condition, and the Catalog lists it as available (`GET /tools`).

title: The member opens the catalog
description: The member opens the Catalog, which lists every tool with its status (`GET /tools`).

title: The member borrows an available tool
description: The member picks an available tool and borrows it (`POST /loans`).

title: When a check fails, the borrow is refused with the first failing reason
description: If the member or the tool is unknown, the member has an overdue loan or is at the loan limit, or the tool needs repair or is on loan, the borrow is refused with the first reason, in that order.

title: The library answers with the loan and its due date
description: The new loan comes back with the date the tool is due back.

title: The librarian finds the loan and inspects the tool
description: When the member brings the tool back, the librarian finds the loan and inspects the tool.

title: The librarian records the condition and, optionally, a note
description: The librarian records the condition, `good` or `needs_repair`, and, optionally, a note (`POST /loans/{loanId}/return`).

title: A return with no valid condition is refused
description: A return with no condition or another value is refused, as is the return of an unknown loan or of a loan already returned.

title: The library answers with the returned loan and whether it was late
description: The returned loan comes back with whether it came back on a day after its due date.

title: The catalog shows the tool as available, or as needing repair
description: A tool returned in good condition is available again, unless damage was reported on it during the loan; one returned needing repair is out of lending until it is mended (`GET /tools`).

title: A librarian marks a damaged tool as needing repair, with a note
description: A librarian finds a damaged tool and marks it as needing repair with a note (`POST /tools/{toolId}/damage`). If it is on loan, the loan carries on.

title: The catalog shows the tool needing repair, and borrowing it is refused
description: The Catalog shows the tool as needing repair (or on loan), and a borrow of it is refused (`GET /tools`).

title: Once fixed, the librarian marks it repaired, and it is available again
description: Once the tool is fixed, the librarian marks it repaired (`POST /tools/{toolId}/repair`), and the catalog shows it as available.
